summary: The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I changed only `solution/core.py`. The root cause was that binary operations popped their operands in the wrong order: `a, b = pop(), pop()` took the top of the stack as the left operand, so `SUB`, `LT`, `GT`, and the others computed with reversed arguments. That made `PUSH 1; PUSH 2; LT` return 0 and kept the countdown loop from ever decrementing, which hit the step limit. It also meant `DIV`/`MOD` checked the wrong operand for zero. I changed the pop to `b, a = pop(), pop()` so the top is the right-hand operand. I also fixed `SWAP`, which had the same ordering problem: it pushed its values back in the original order, so it never changed the stack. The public API in `solution/__init__.py` is unchanged, and nothing under `tests/` was touched.
